  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  January 11, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on January 11, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera , Planning Department
  Cpt.Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osais / Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services / Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on December 14, 2023.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Matthew Galimore DBA American Heart Asssociation to host a Community Health Fair
  Event at 400 Beach Ave.; Rogers Park, Public Property, on Saturday, January 27, 2024,
  from 11:00 a.m – 4:30 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant to adhere to all recommendations outlined by
  the IPD / Planninng Department / Parks & Recreations Department; Applicant Approved
  for one (1) day event at Rogers Park; Applicant to hire (2) Professional Licensed Security
  Guards for the safety of attendees and employees; All Securtiy Guards / Event Staff shall
  wear reflective vests; A Watch Commander will be notified; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00383307)
 Permits & License Committee  January 11, 2024
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

Item #2:  Juan A Nuno DBA Northgate Markets to host a Valentine’s Day Flower Sale Event at 10801
  S. Prairie Ave., Private & Public Property, on Tuesday, February 13, 2024 from 10:00 a.m.
  – 8:00 p.m.; and Wednesday, February 14, 2024, from 7:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant
  Approved for two (2) day event within Northgate Market #35 parking lot; Applicant to adhere
  to all recommendations outlined by the IPD / Planninng Department and Public Works
  Department; Applicant to hire two (2) Licensed Professional Security Guards to assist IPD
  with public safety; must have water - filled barriers during the event; no vehicular traffic
  where flowers are sold;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00382556).

Item #3:  Thorsten D Mier DBA Life in Motion Group LLC and Kick-it World LLC to host a Kickit World
  Street Sports Festival Event at 8729 Aviation Blvd., Volume Studios, private Property, on
  Saturday, April 6, 2024 from 12:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant Approved for one (1) day
  event within Volume Studios Parking Lot; Applicants must adhere to all department
  recommendations; Applicant to hire one (1) Sergeant, four (4) Inglewood Police Officers;(20)
  security guards to assist IPD with Public Safety; Applicant to pay $1.30 per admission fee;
  /submit Admission Tax Form and Parking Plan etc to the City of Inglewood Finance
  Department; Applicant must provide the list of attendees / celebrities to IPD; Maintain site
  at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant
  and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00383279).

Item # 4:  Jeffrey King DBA Rolling Loud to host a Rolling Loud Event at 1001 Stadium Dr.; Sofi
  Stadium, Private Property, from Friday, March 15, 2024, from 3:00 p.m. – 11:00 p.m.
  Saturday, March 16, 2024, from 12:00 p.m. – 11:00 p.m. and Sunday, March 17, 2024,
  from 12:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicants must adhere to all department
  recommendations; TCO Staffing TBD; Rolling Loud Management must submit a list of
  workers assisting with Carnival Rides; must submit DL/ID/ DOB of every single worker;
  must receive list (2) weeks before the event start date; ABC License / Parking Tax
  document / Admission fee for $1.30 ( per person) must be submitted to the City of
  Inglewood Finance Department if applicable ; Applicant to pay a $200,000.00 deposit
 Permits & License Committee  January 11, 2024
Minutes  Page 3 of 4

  flat fee if applicant shall go over the approved event time; IPD/ LACO Fire Department will

  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this
  event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00362570).
